mapper.select: select id, ip, port, parent_id from nodes
select n.id, n.ip, n.port, n.parent_id, exists (select 1 from nodes child where child.parent_id = n.id) as has_child from nodes n where parent_id = #{parentId}
select n.id, n.ip, n.port, n.parent_id, exists (select 1 from nodes child where child.parent_id = n.id) as has_child from nodes n where n.parent_id is null
mapper.insert: insert into nodes (ip, port, parent_id) values(#{ip}, #{port}, #{parentId})
